name: front lever reps
description: A rep-based version of the front lever, pulling the body in a horizontal line from a bar. It trains the lats, upper back and core.
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Lift your body into a front lever: straight and level with the floor, arms straight.
Keep your body level and pull the bar toward your hips by bending your elbows.
Lower slowly back to straight arms without dropping your hips.
Lower your legs to rest between sets.
